body:
Designs get a default theme of named tokens, so a design says "primary" rather than a raw color, and a design's look stays consistent.

### Do

- Define one default theme of tokens, such as colors, spacing and text sizes. The token list is agreed with the human before building it.
- The renderer draws the default components from these tokens.
- The validator knows which token names exist, and refuses an unknown one.
- A token's values aren't stored in each design, so a design refers to tokens by name.

### Acceptance

- Tests: components draw from token values, changing a token's value changes what is drawn, and an unknown token is refused, naming the element.

### Left out

An editable theme, "promote to token", and a project's own theme. How a project's own look is represented stays open in feature:7c9cdfad16609a44.
title: ui: default theme of tokens
